title: Tile Town Pet Vet Magnetic Tiles Set (48 pieces)

comparisons.notes: Tile Town Pet Vet 48-piece magnetic tiles set with sound/light, new, free shipping, $24.99
Tile Town Pet Vet Set, UPC 630996820698, 48-piece set with vet, dog, cat and bunny figures, new, $29.99

writeup: Tile Town's Pet Vet magnetic tile set is $9.99 on Woot. The 48-piece kit includes action tiles (a pet door, scale and X-ray machine) plus vet, kid, dog, cat and bunny figures, and works with other major magnetic tile brands. Other stores sell it for $24.99 to $29.99, so this is about 60% less, with a limit of 10 per customer.
